definition: Tensor Processing Unit, a custom hardware accelerator designed by Google specifically for accelerating machine learning workloads, particularly tensor operations.
details: TPUs are used extensively for training and serving large-scale models, offering high throughput for the matrix multiplications central to neural network computation.
story: Picture an engineer at a cluttered workbench, turning a clever idea over in their hands until it finally clicks. At its heart it is a simple notion, once you strip away the fancy name. A small key that opens a much bigger door. It is one of those ideas that feels obvious only after someone shows it to you. And that idea, made concrete, is TPU.
